sectors.trend: Nasdaq 100 at record; AI enthusiasm (Meta Muse, Anthropic IPO, Apple/Google crypto dev hiring) driving rally. Tech stocks 'haven't been this cheap since ChatGPT launch.'
sectors.implications: AI capex cycle accelerating; Meta Muse outpacing ChatGPT early mobile suggests competitive moat erosion for OpenAI. Anthropic debut and derailed IPO plans create volatility. FSLY, MRVL, Lumentum benefit from AI infrastructure demand.

sectors.trend: Crude seesaws on Hormuz diplomacy and Saudi pipeline fix; oil traders bet on price drop at record pace. Diesel shortage from Iran/Ukraine wars to last into 2027. Big Ag vs Big Oil over diesel export ban.
sectors.implications: Short-term oil relief supports equities, but structural diesel scarcity threatens transport stocks and US inflation. Range Resources (RRC) down 17.2% but still attractive. Aviation stocks pressured by diesel costs.

sectors.trend: Gold above $4,330 on record Chinese imports; silver at highs pre US-China talks; copper near record on tight China supplies.
sectors.implications: China's gold accumulation signals de-dollarization and reserve diversification. Copper tightness supports industrial demand thesis. Gold miners (NG, SBSW, SA) offer asymmetric upside post-Q2 declines.

sectors.trend: BTC and ETH surge to January levels; Strategy buys $75M BTC, Bitmine $75M ETH; Grayscale ZCash 3-for-1 split; Kalshi seeks CFTC margin approval; CFTC investigates Polymarket fraud.
sectors.implications: Institutional accumulation accelerating. Regulatory clarity improving (Kalshi, CFTC). Apple/Google hiring crypto devs signals mainstream integration. 'Crypto winter is over' narrative gaining traction.

sectors.trend: Treasury yields easing; traders hedge for shallower Fed hike cycle; CD rates at 4.40%; Fed official says fighting inflation 'painful'; rising yields wreaking havoc on bond market.
sectors.implications: Yield curve compression benefits growth equities. 4.40% CD rates offer attractive fixed-income alternative. AGNC 14%+ yield in S&P MidCap 400. Bond market stress could spill into equities.

sectors.trend: Molina +70.7%, Centene +98.8% in Q2 on healthcare demand; Wendy's operator files bankruptcy; Shake Shack misses; Disney cuts prices to $59; Nike hit with bearish note.
sectors.implications: Healthcare/insurance outperformance reflects defensive rotation. Consumer discretionary under pressure. McDonald's/Wendy's distress signals consumer spending fragility.

market_outlook.short_term: Bullish but fragile. Nasdaq record and falling oil/yields support equities, but diesel shortage, political volatility, and private credit stress create tail risks. Crypto momentum strong. Watch Anthropic IPO as sentiment catalyst. 1-3 month: +3-5% for tech-heavy indices, flat for broad market.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive with caveats. AI capex cycle and China commodity demand support growth, but diesel scarcity into 2027, sticky inflation, and political uncertainty cap upside. Gold/copper structural bull intact. Healthcare/insurance outperformance likely to continue. 6-12 month: moderate upside for quality tech, defensive tilt in consumer.
